title: Me llamo + name
explanation: Use me llamo plus a name to introduce yourself. Keep the pattern stable when the name changes.

title: Asking a name
explanation: Use ¿Cómo te llamas? to ask one person their name in a friendly introduction.

title: ñ, j and ll in names
explanation: Spanish ñ, j and ll are important in names and first words. In this course, ll uses the same broad yeista pronunciation category as consonantal y. ll is two lowercase l letters: l + l. Do not confuse it with two uppercase I letters.

title: Polite introduction replies
explanation: Use mucho gusto or encantado/encantada after meeting someone. Igualmente means likewise.

title: Introduction origin seed
explanation: Use soy de plus a place for a simple origin line in an introduction. Keep de in the pattern.
